output.summary: A fan palm native to tropical and subtropical South and Southeast Asia, it is a tall, sturdy tree crowned with large fan-shaped leaves. Its fruit and sprouts are eaten raw or cooked, while its sap is consumed fresh or made into palm wine, sugar, jaggery and candy.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit and sprouts are eaten raw or cooked; sap is drunk fresh or processed into wine, sugar, jaggery and candy.
